title: Topocode internal modules
summary: Fourteen private @topo/* workspaces. Arrows are selected direct dependencies from package manifests, arranged as a readable composition spine, not a complete edge drawing or runtime call graph. Select a module for every declared incoming/outgoing internal dependency and its responsibility. @topo/eslint-config is tooling; the other thirteen are bundled by @jdylanmc/topo-code. External context is a separate linked map.
